subject: mdl/sessionmanager: some refactor of MDL loop and move sessionmanager from util to session pkg (#62671)
summary: Reviewed the refactor that moves `ProcessInfo`/`SessionManager` from `pkg/util` to `pkg/session/sessmgr` and updates session/planner/sessionctx interfaces accordingly. The only behavioral-touching change in scoped modules is the MDL check plumbing (`RemoveLockDDLJobs` now operates on pre-parsed `mdldef.JobMDL.TableIDs` instead of repeatedly parsing strings), which appears semantics-equivalent and does not introduce new concurrency/transaction/session correctness risks.
